cohort: 489 women who gave birth at the Glenn C. Olson Memorial Primary Hospital in rural Ethiopia between January 1, 2011, and March 31, 2014
finding: Maternity waiting home use was associated with a lower risk of childbirth complications, fetal and newborn complications, and maternal complications, as well as higher birth weight and 5-min Apgar scores.
mod_finding: MWH users were more likely to undergo a caesarean section and less likely to have a spontaneous vaginal delivery, obstructed labor, or stillbirth.
birth_weight: Median birth weight was 3.5 kg for offspring of MWH users and 3.2 kg for offspring of non-users
